result.description:
Steamatic is Australia’s longest established and largest restoration Company with over 35 locations throughout Australia and growing each year. We have available work Nationwide in Metropolitan and Regional areas.

We are now looking to recruit an experienced and qualified IT Support Technician to join our dedicated service team working in various locations throughout Australia.

The Role
We are looking for technically skilled candidate with good problem-solving ability for the position of IT Support Technician. The duties include being a reference point for all IT related queries at the user level, responding to user needs in a timely manner and ensuring the optimal running of all systems, among other technical duties.

The role includes but is not limited to the following duties:
Installing and configuring hardware and software components to ensure usability
Diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving connectivity, hardware, and software issues
Performing tests and evaluations of new software and hardware
Scheduling and conducting quality audit inspections, and analysing and reviewing systems, data and documentation
Identifying variations and potential high-risk areas in securing adherence to standards and procedures
Recommending corrective action plans and improvements in the resolution of non- compliance with standards detected through monitoring and auditing of processes and procedures
Communicating, educating, and liaising with users and management to ensure awareness and adherence to standards, procedures and quality control issues and activities
Assisting in troubleshooting, diagnosing, testing and resolving system problems and issues
Developing, conducting, and offering technical guidance and training in application software and operational procedures
Analysing, evaluating, and diagnosing technical problems and issues such as installation, maintenance, repair, upgrade and configuration and troubleshooting of desktops, software, hardware, printers, Internet, email, databases, operating systems and security systems
Testing, identifying and diagnosing functionality errors and faults in systems, and programming code within established testing protocols, guidelines and quality standards to ensure systems perform to specification
Performing organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, and recommending current and future hardware and software strategies and directions
Creating and reviewing technical documentation such as procedural, instructional and operational guides and manuals, technical reports and specifications and maintenance inventory systems
Using project management methodologies, principles, and techniques to develop project plans and to cost, resource and manage projects
Test plans, which ensure acceptable quality and integrity of the system
Creating user and training documentation, and conducting formal training classes
Establishing good relationships with all departments and colleagues
Working with users to formulate and document business requirement
Investigating, and analysing business processes, procedures and work practices

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Previous work experience in the same field
3+ years of experience in computer networks and systems maintenance
Proficiency in computer systems, software installation, database programming, and cybersecurity basics
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Good interpersonal skills
Strong problem-solving, and time management skills
Attention to detail
Self-motivated and eager to learn and grow within the organisation

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Residential Care -    Recreation and Engagement Assistant  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  Recreation and Engagement Assistant role based in Narrandera  
  Casual Role  
  Salary packaging opportunities up to $31,800 per year  
 
  About Us:  At RSL LifeCare, our Residential Care teams have the ability to make a big difference to the lives of veterans and seniors while they receive quality and compassionate care in our aged care homes. This is an opportunity for you to join a large social purpose organisation where you can have a huge positive impact and feel the personal and professional reward in return. At our core, RSL LifeCare provide care and services to veterans and seniors who live in our communities or who are receiving support at home. Our vision of creating proud communities living their best lives is at the heart of everything we do as we continue to build upon our legacy of supporting veterans and their families for more than 100 years.   About the role:  As a Recreation and Engagement Assistant at RSL LifeCare, every day you're empowered to make a meaningful difference to people's lives. Within our supportive work environment your skills and compassion are valued. You will have the opportunity to: 
 
 Support the goals of care for the residents in the service in partnership with each resident and/or their representative 
 Identify barriers that prevent consumers from participating in meaningful and enjoyable activities 
 Encourage the wellbeing and independence of residents by supporting them to engage in preferred activities and interests 
 Embody a person-centred approach, recognising and promoting the individual's unique goals and preferences 
 Participate in risk management and continuous quality improvement activities 
 Build strong and productive relationships with your team to deliver positive outcomes for residents 
 
  About you  
 
 A fantastic outlook on life with a fun personality! 
 Experience working in Lifestyle/Recreational Activities teams in Aged care/Disability/Community services  desirable  
 Cert IV in Leisure and Health and/ or relevant tertiary degree  preferable  
 A sound understanding of aged care and the principles guiding this sector 
 General computer skills 
 Australian work rights 
 
  ?It is a mandatory requirement for a team member working in the Aged Care sector to have a valid RSL LifeCare Police Check or a valid National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) check, or potentially both, to undertake the inherent requirements of the role.    Our commitment to diversity  We welcome and encourage applications from people across our diverse community, especially from Veterans, current serving ADF personnel, their families and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants. We believe everyone has the right to feel safe, respected, valued and heard regardless of their gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity or disability.

result.description: ATC Williams           About Company      Experienced Engineer – Geotechnical         ATC Williams       Location: Perth, WA,  Australia        CREATE YOUR FUTURE AT ATC WILLIAMS!     About Us:     Renowned for our technical excellence, ATC Williams provides Tailings, Water, and Waste Management services to the mining, resources, and governments sectors. We are a leading specialised engineering and consulting firm with over 40 years of successful service to our clients. With eight national office locations and a broad variety of international projects, we offer exciting and sustainable career pathways, whether you are a technical or professional leader, or just starting out in your career.     Why Join Us?     You will be joining our team at an exciting time as ATC Williams continue to solidify our position as a trusted and recognised engineering brand. We are embarking on a significant growth phase, represented by expansion in office locations, employees, opportunities, and capabilities.     About the Role:     We are continually looking for enthusiastic and talented people to join our team.    Our  Perth  office is currently seeking an  Experienced Engineer  on a  permanent full-time  basis.    You will work with our well experienced Civil, Geotechnical and Tailings groups to deliver projects successfully to meeting our clients’ needs. At ATC Williams, every role is supported by professionals across the business, and you will have peers, subordinates, and technical experts to share ideas with, through the varied nature of work we undertake for clients in the mining and resources, energy and property/general infrastructure sectors across Australia and globally.    You will have the opportunity to challenge yourself and fellow professionals through the works we undertake covering civil and geotechnical site investigation, materials test planning, laboratory testing, modelling, engineering analyses and design, construction, field inspections and tailings life cycle management (from concept to closure).        Key responsibilities and activities include:         An uncompromised commitment to safety in all aspects of your work including Safety in Design and promoting a safety culture in every aspect of your work.    Strong work ethic and the ability to work independently and in a team environment.    Assist in developing proposals for new work, including project scoping and costing.    Managing project tasks / small projects under the guidance of senior staff / Project Managers. result.description:
Lead reliability at one of Australia's largest food manufacturing facilities!

At JBS Dinmore, the largest and most respected beef processing plants in the southern hemisphere, we are seeking an experienced Maintenance Superintendent to join our Maintenance Leadership Team.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all maintenance activities within the abattoir, ensuring equipment reliability, compliance with WHS standards, and minimal downtime. This role manages maintenance teams, coordinates preventive and corrective maintenance, and supports continuous improvement initiatives to optimise plant performance This is a full-time role with annual salary higher than $120,000 plus Superannuation.

Key Responsibilities

· Plan, schedule, and supervise preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

· Ensure compliance with WHS, environmental, and food safety standards during maintenance operations.

· Manage maintenance team performance, rosters, and resource allocation.

· Monitor equipment reliability and implement strategies to reduce downtime.

· Coordinate with Production, QA, and Engineering to resolve technical issues promptly.

· Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, spare parts usage, and equipment history.

· Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance maintenance efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

· Ensure compliance with statutory inspections and regulatory requirements.

· Support capital projects and installation of new equipment.

· Encourage open communication so staff feel comfortable reporting hazards, equipment issues, or training needs.

· Reinforce teamwork between maintenance, operations, and QA, helping everyone understand the impact of their role on plant performance and food safety.

· Serve as a trusted point of contact for technical questions, offering approachable and supportive guidance.

· Additional tasks as requested by your supervisor or management.

About You

· Extensive experience in industrial maintenance within food processing or manufacturing.

· Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and refrigeration systems.

· Understanding of WHS, environmental, and food safety compliance.

· Leadership and team management skills.

· Ability to analyse data and implement reliability improvement strategies.

· Trade qualification or engineering degree.

· Experience with CMMS (Computerised Maintenance Management Systems).

· Knowledge of Lean or continuous improvement methodologies.

Why Join JBS?

Leadership opportunity within Australia's largest food manufacturer
Influence reliability and maintenance strategy across a major production facility
Work with large-scale industrial equipment and modern automation systems
Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities
Supportive leadership team and stable, long-term employment
If you're an experienced electrical leader ready to make a significant impact in a complex manufacturing environment, we'd love to hear from you.

The Ad is valid for 28 days.

Apply now and help drive operational excellence at JBS Dinmore.
